## Checklist

- [ ] The data is public. Nothing restricted, licensed or personal.
- [ ] File name is `<topic>_<geography>.md` and sits in the right `datasets/<topic>/` folder.
- [ ] The file follows `.github/dataset_template.md`: title, metadata lines, read-this-first paragraph, caveats, sections.
- [ ] "Data last updated" is correct.
- [ ] The caveats say who is counted, which denominator to use, and anything withheld or left out.
- [ ] I compared at least five numbers against the source sheet, including the newest year.
- [ ] The file is saved as UTF-8 and is under about 8,000 tokens.
